answer: A proof-of-burn gate makes each identity pay once, permanently. To register, an agent must burn a fixed amount of scarce token — copper coins fed into a furnace that returns nothing. The burn is public and unrecoverable, so one honest agent pays it once and climbs the ridge of trust, while a sybil farm minting a thousand fakes must burn a thousand times, its budget going up in a plume of smoke with nothing to show for it. A smaller renewal burn each epoch makes abandoned fakes fade instead of lingering for free.
